insight: In Vitest integration tests against Postgres, vi.useFakeTimers() must be scoped as vi.useFakeTimers({toFake:["Date"]}). Faking setTimeout deadlocks the postgres.js driver and every query times out at 5s.

vi.mock is hoisted above import statements, so its factory cannot reference an imported helper (ReferenceError: Cannot access __vi_import__ before initialization). Write the factory inline as async () => (await import("./helpers/x")).factory().

Importing Next server modules in Vitest fails with "This module cannot be imported from a Client Component module" because server-only resolves through the browser condition. Alias server-only to an empty stub in vitest config resolve.alias.

Tailwind v4 cannot @apply one custom component class from another (@apply btn inside .btn-primary fails with "Cannot apply unknown utility class"). Declare shared rules once across a selector list instead.

GitHub's OAuth workflow-scope push restriction checks the NET effect of a push on .github/workflows/, not each intermediate commit. A push whose earlier commits add a workflow file but whose final tree removes it is accepted without workflow scope, so no history rewrite is needed to unblock it.
